نتواطأ (form VI)
# نَتَوَاطَأُ (natawāṭaʔu) /na.ta.waː.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# نَتَوَاطَأَ (natawāṭaʔa) /na.ta.waː.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# نَتَوَاطَأْ (natawāṭaʔ) /na.ta.waː.tˤaʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
